# Academic Heights World School (AHWS)
AHWS is a premium CBSE affiliated Senior Secondary school located in Pitampura, Delhi.
We follow the NEP 2020 aligned SPROUT Curriculum, focusing on holistic child development, AI, Robotics, and sports.
- Admissions: Open for 2026-27 (Nursery to Class XII)
- Contact: +91-8860455000 | info@ahws.edu.in
- Location: SD-QD Block, Near TV Tower, Pitampura, Delhi
